# .ai-project.yml
# AI Project System — Project Configuration Contract
# Spec: governance/ai-project-yml-spec.md v2.7.0

governance:
  source: ./governance
  version: "7.1.0"
  ref: master

project:
  name: ai-project-system
  description: "AI Project System governance source repository"

# CFO PR review gate — Layer 8 sees PR changes before a merge happens.
# enabled (default): merge-ready PRs surface in the Progress Digest's Open Decisions
#   section for CFO diff review before merge.
# disabled: merges proceed automatically (agentic auto-merge), no gate.
# See governance/systems/creation-chat-guide.md (CFO PR Review Gate).
cfo_review_gate: enabled

# Hybrid model mapping for unattended 24/7 autonomous cluster execution.
# Evidence-grounded mapping (Epic E30.2, P9-M30) — derived from the measured
# token-burn dataset, not assumption. Policy + per-key rationale:
#   .ai-project/artifacts/reference/token-measurement/model-routing-policy.md
# Audit report + gap records (G1-G12):
#   .ai-project/artifacts/reference/token-measurement/audit-report.md
# M31's manual-mode guardrail verifies chats against this block; keep it in
# sync with the policy (divergence is an error).
# `creation` and `epic_manual` (added E31.3, P9-M31) are manual-chat-only keys with no
# agentic dispatch surface — see governance/systems/chat-hierarchy.md "Manual Chat Model
# Verification" for the mapping and governance/ai-project-yml-spec.md §3.4 for the schema.
# The five paid-frontier keys moved claude-opus-4-8 -> claude-opus-5 on 2026-07-28 (HQ
# Ruling, P10-M34 escalation): a same-tier version refresh after claude-opus-4-8 stopped
# being offered in the harness. The policy's TIER rows (P1-P4) are untouched — only its
# mapping table. See .ai-project/artifacts/rulings/2026-07-28__ai-project-system-hq__
# ruling__paid-frontier-model-mapping-refresh.md.
# The two agentic epic lanes moved qwen2.5-coder:14b -> qwen3-coder:30b on 2026-07-28
# (Epic P10-M34-E34.3), applying the runtime choice M33 settled by running it: keep
# Ollama, raise the model tier. E33.2 Run A proved the 14b returns exit 0 having done
# nothing (0 tool rounds, 0 files changed); Run B did mergeable work on the same runtime
# at 30b, and E33.4 ran a second real epic on it. Unlike the paid-frontier refresh above,
# this IS a policy-row change (rows P6/P7 name the model in their own Decision column) and
# carries new cited evidence per the policy's Change discipline.
# Loadability envelope, honestly: qwen3-coder:30b (Q4_K_M, 18.6 GB) exceeds this box's
# 16 GB VRAM and partially offloads to RAM (12.9 GB VRAM / 21.4 GB total). Like-for-like
# on E33.2's epic it ran ~9.4 tok/s against the 14b's 12.2 - slower, but it finishes.
# See docs/phases/P10__Fleet_Adoption_and_Local_Inference_Proving/
# P10-M33-E33.2__runtime-decision.md and .ai-project/artifacts/agentic-runs/
# P10-M33-E33.2/run-record.md + P10-M33-E33.4/run-record.md.
models:
  hq: remote:claude-opus-5
  phase: remote:claude-opus-5
  milestone: remote:claude-opus-5
  epic_dev: local:qwen3-coder:30b
  epic_qa: local:qwen3-coder:30b
  creation: remote:claude-opus-5
  epic_manual: remote:claude-opus-5

# Visual artifacts (M22/M27, VA-1, SN-17) — default-on, opt-out via enabled: false.
# This repo is ENABLED (enabled: true) as of Epic E29.2 (P8-M29): the live local
# ComfyUI endpoint is proven reachable and test_helper_generates_against_endpoint
# passes for real against it. `--type diagrams`/`infographics`/`video` are all
# Generative (ComfyUI) categories (AOG §16.3; naming collision with Structural mode
# resolved in Epic E29.1, P8-M29) — Structural diagrams (Mermaid/PlantUML) need no
# visual_artifacts config at all and remain fully independent of this flag (AOG
# §16.3/§16.8). Contributors without a reachable ComfyUI endpoint: see
# AI_PROJECT_SKIP_LIVE_ENDPOINT_TESTS in tests/integration/test_visual_artifacts_helper.py.
# See governance/ai-project-yml-spec.md §3.5 for the field contract.
visual_artifacts:
  enabled: true
  comfyui_url: http://localhost:8188
  types:
    - diagrams
    - infographics
    - video
  visual_required_for_specs: true
